name: Methamphetamine
warning: High-dose / sleep-deprived presentation. Uses peripheral flicker. Photosensitivity note applies.
tierNotes: Threshold: extra crispness — the over-sharpened vigilant look (early sharpenHalo); snow near-deniable (VSS density is quadratic in weight).
Light: fine visual snow appears on flat surfaces — sparse salt-and-pepper specks shimmering at a fixed ~14 Hz, not per-frame static.

Common: slow granular texture-crawl in FLAT regions only (edges/objects hold still) + first peripheral shadow blobs that emerge from the scene's own dark corners and vanish when the mouse (gaze) approaches.

Strong: frequent image-driven shadow events, harsh contrast, cold desaturation, denser snow, plus 'vibrating vision' (fast constant eye-wiggle blur) and a nervous fast pattern-breathe on edges/textures — fast/jittery, restless/wired rather than trippy.

Heavy: rare humanoid silhouettes (p≈0.032/s) against whichever frame edge is darker, in three poses (standing/hunched/crouch); constant crawl + strong pattern-breathe on every edge; full snowstorm; strong vibrating-vision blur; rare 'Transformations' flicker (p≈0.02/s) where a high-edge object briefly mis-samples itself. No psychedelic geometry/rainbow — PW doesn't document those for meth.
